label: Weight tends to vary as the cube of linear dimensions during growth
statement_en: Whatever the law of increase in a linear dimension, volume and therefore weight tend to vary as the cube of linear dimensions, which mainly (though not wholly) explains why the human weight curve differs in shape from the stature curve.

hypotheses.name: thompson1917-ch03-07#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: A single linear dimension L and mass W of one body family; fixed shape and constant density are what W = k L^3 encodes.

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
kernelChecked: If W L = k L^3 for all L > 0 with k > 0, then for L1 ≠ L2 the log-log slope (log W L2 − log W L1)/(log L2 − log L1) equals exactly 3 (cubeLaw_loglog_exponent) and W L2 / W L1 = (L2/L1)^3 (cubeLaw_ratio).
Contrapositive: two sizes with a log-log slope b ≠ 3 rule out W = k L^3 for every k (not_cubeLaw_of_exponent_ne_three).
assumed: A single linear dimension L and mass W of one body family; fixed shape and constant density are what W = k L^3 encodes.
Thompson's "mainly (though not wholly)" is not formalised: the theorem is exact, the law is approximate, and the tolerance band [2.5, 3.5] the claim test uses is a decision rule outside the module.
No data enters the module; the measured exponents are read from the claims thread's result files and pointed to.

length_ratio_vs_reference.note: an implied exponent is ln(X/X_ref) / ln(L/L_ref) against the single reference specimen (Cypselurus hiraii, Park and Choi 2010 Table 1 model L3, SL 0.203 m), so the denominator approaches zero as L approaches L_ref and ordinary specimen variation is amplified without limit. About 1% relative uncertainty in L against the studio's 0.1 decision band means the comparison carries no information until |ln(L/L_ref)| >= 0.1, i.e. a length ratio outside [0.905, 1.105]. Measured in the real siblings: L1 (ratio 1.0099) implied a v_min exponent of -1.43 and L2 (1.0296) -3.86 against a target of 0.5, and model N (0.9951) -60.8, so accepted laws fired red on unedited wild-type flying fish (blind evaluator, 2026-11-01)

C7b.basis: evaluated against one reference specimen (Cypselurus hiraii, Park and Choi 2010 Table 1 model L3); an isometric family is one body plan, so other clades are out of scope
